escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still with real depth of field, a dark creative studio at night, the native layout of a vertical feed ad). GEOGRAPHY, the most important instruction: the UPPER 40% of the frame is one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte plaster studio wall with fine visible texture: no light falls on it, no glow, no bokeh, no lamps, no screens and no objects; it is calm from edge to edge. Everything lit lives between 42% and 80% of the frame height. The LOWEST 20% of the frame is the near-black matte edge of a long work table right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light. THE MOMENT: a Latin American creative director in her early forties, short dark hair, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands slightly RIGHT of center, framed from the waist up, the top of her head at about 46% of the frame height, the table edge cutting her at the waist; head almost frontal, she looks straight into the lens with quiet confidence. Her RIGHT arm is fully visible from shoulder to hand: in her open hand, at chest height, she holds ONE glowing key visual made of light, a single vertical image with a bold sweeping orange (#FF6500) form on deep navy. From that one key visual, a wide FAN of about twenty thin frames of light opens out to the left and back into the depth of the studio, between 44% and 78% of the frame height: a story, a square post, a wide banner, a billboard, a phone screen, a video frame, each a different shape and size yet each carrying the same orange form, like the same idea multiplying across formats. The key visual in her hand is the brightest element and the only key light on her face and hand; NO fill light, the far side of her face in shadow. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines her hair and shoulders. Thin haze catches the fan, only below 42%. The frames are rounded rectangles: no circles, no dots, no spheres, no rings. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two and a half meters away at chest height, 85mm at f/2, nothing foreshortened. Fine dust, real sensor grain, genuine depth of field. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte edge of a long work table right in front of the lens, crossing the whole width of the lowest 20% of the frame, completely out of focus, non-reflective, outside every light

texto.muro: one continuous, evenly dark, deep navy-black matte plaster studio wall with fine visible texture
